The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 042c7730f058d508), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 36. statement: There are complete discretely valued fields Kb ⊂ K′ b of characteristic zero, with valuation rings Rb ⊂ R′ b, and a smooth projective genus-one curve X/Rb with the following properties. (i) The extension K′ b/Kb is cyclic Galois of degree n; the extension R′ b/Rb is finite étale Galois, its residue extension is F′/F0, and the two fields have the same value group. Moreover, Kb contains Qp and all mth roots of unity, where m = |J|. (ii) The special fiber of X is E/F0. There is a relatively ample effective divisor D on X of fiber degree n. (iii) Over R′ b there are pairwise disjoint sections ξ1, . . . , ξn reducing respectively to t1, . . . , tn. They avoid D, and their union descends to a finite étale effective divisor on X. Under the cyclic descent action the sections are permuted by ξi ↦→ ξi+1.
